channel.title: FarmVision Press Room & Product Updates
channel.description: Official announcements, product milestones, and pricing news from FarmVision

item.title: FarmVision Unveils Edge AI Sensor for Greenhouse Climate Optimization
item.description: FarmVision announced the release of its specialized Edge AI microclimate sensor, delivering sub-degree temperature regulation and automated CO2 dosing for indoor commercial growers.

item.title: FarmVision Introduces Flexible Pay-Per-Acre Subscription Pricing Tier
item.description: FarmVision has revamped its enterprise pricing structure, launching a low-entry pay-per-acre subscription model designed to reduce upfront capital hurdles for mid-sized family farms.

item.title: Global Agricultural Fertilizer Logistics and Rail Freight Overview
item.description: North American rail car availability for potash and nitrogen shipments improved 4% week-over-week as regional transit hubs cleared backlog.
